title: I saw the other game and also told claude to make a crazy game by itself.
author: felsspat

comments.author: felsspat
comments.body:
This is the post that inspired me: [click](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1xtrtf2/this_guy_asked_fable_52_to_go_wild_making_a_game/)

Prompt: 

>  "Build a crazy browser game on your own, without asking me anything. It must not require a server-side language, so it should run purely in the browser. You have two hours. Feel free to use Blender, WSL with Python, and so on."

Took 10 minutes :)

replies.author: Valdaraak
replies.body: Yea, one-shots aren't impressive. We've all done them, we've all seen them, and they're nice for a few minutes until you realize they're the definition of slop.

replies.author: felsspat
replies.body: I actually never saw them until the other post and found it funny what the AI brews up without instructions. It somehow never occurred to me to try that.
